title: User can lose the right to claim tokens when calling `claim`
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  In case of emergency the `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` can withdraw `BIO_TOKEN` balance from the contract. At the same time there are no restrictions for users to try `claim` tokens. Since the `_safeClaimTransfer` can transfer the actual balance instead of the amount users will receive 0 `BIO_TOKEN` and lose the right to claim tokens again. Moreover the `VBIO_TOKEN` contract also will receive 0 but will accept a vesting schedule with the correct amount. So there will not be enough tokens in the `VBIO_TOKEN` contract balance for all ves
